Ṛg-veda, the formal name of the collection of Ṛcs, first appears in the Brāhmaṇas, and thereafter frequently in the Āraṇyakas and Upaniṣads.
Foot notes aitareya brāhmaṇa, i. 32, and implied in taittirīya brāhmaṇa, iii. 12, 9, 1; Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, vi. 5, 4, 6; 8, 3; xii. 3, 4, 9.
aitareya Āraṇyaka, iii. 2, 3. 5; śāṅkhāyana Āraṇyaka, viii. 3. 8.
Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, i. 5, 12; ii. 4, 10; iv. 1, 6; 5, 11; Chāndogya upaniṣad, i. 3, 7; iii. 1, 2. 3; 15, 7; vii. 1, 2. 4; 2, 1; 7, 1.
